🌼 Spring is here, and it’s the perfect time to declutter and pack for your next move! Here are some tips to make packing a breeze:

3️⃣ Label everything on TWO sides, so you can easily find what you need.  
4️⃣ Pack heavy items in small boxes for easier lifting!
